summary: UI event dispatch: iterates a2 WORD-sized event codes at a3. Event 1 resolves a handler string through the chain this+0x18 -> this+0x68 -> +0x60; event 28 resolves the handler string through the same chain to +0x58. A null handler string falls back to global byte_5EA438, then sub_4988D0 is invoked with the resolved string. Finally forwards (this, a2, a3, a4) to virtual slot 8 (vtable offset 32) of the widget.

Guard: event code == 1 selects the left-click/select handler path.
Guard: event code == 28 selects the alternate handler path.
Read v9 = this[6] (pointer at this+0x18) as the intermediate handler object.
Guard on the intermediate handler pointer v9 being non-null.
Read v10 = *(v9 + 80), the manager/handler pointer held at this+0x68.
Guard on the manager/handler pointer v10 being non-null.
Event 1 path: v8 = *(v10 + 96), the handler string at *(this+0x68)+0x60.
Event 28 path: v8 = *(v7 + 88), the handler string at *(this+0x68)+0x58.
Fallback: if the resolved handler string v8 is null, use global byte_5EA438.
Dispatch the resolved handler string: sub_4988D0(v8).
Forward (this, a2, a3, a4) through virtual slot 8: (*(*this + 32))(this, a2, a3, a4); the slot is read from the vtable pointer at this+0x0 (field obj+0x20).
Return the result of the forwarded virtual call.
